description: Check authoritative scan status; defaults to Gmail. provider:outlook reads gated mailbox status or exact jobId, not overall processing completion. Starts require the returned screen. Gmail returns the active lock, live phase/progress, queued or attention-needed periods, completed calendar years, tax-period statuses with their returned labels and inclusive ISO bounds, exclusions and recent outcomes. Use when asked if a scan is running, finished, stuck, or what it is doing. On completion show spreadsheetUrl or reviewExpensesUrl; for setup/reconnection show gmailScanUrl. Read-only.

jobId.description: Optional exact Outlook historical job ID, never guessed.

name: get_scan_status

outputSchema.description: Authoritative live scan state. Fields may be top-level or under data; only success is guaranteed, so treat the rest as optional.

latestScan.description: Most recent scan outcome (success, emailsFound, emailsTagged, timestamp).

lock.description: Scan-lock state (active, startedAt, ageSeconds, dispatchComplete, pendingProcessingCount).
